title: Compiled-Program Runtime Deep-Dive (gameoflife 3x Regression + terrain/hashmap/histogram/nbody Native Profiles)

gameoflife_bisect.input: medium (size=12n, gens=32n, expected=3681094808) — identical to Wave 5C proxy receipt
gameoflife_bisect.root_cause: apply_w7_lower_fast.py lowered p113k_function size cap from 32768 to 2048 (and p113k_function_done 2nd pass to 1024) without a pure-leaf exemption. After inlining 16x step_cell into step, raw pre-fold step exceeds 2048 IR stmts, so p113k_function skips step completely: (1) U32 w32 zero-extensions & copy/DCE never fold (step bloats 3.15x from 467 to 1473 insns), (2) step stays too large for p113i_table_function so run and classify cannot inline step, (3) step exceeds x190_joint_frame's 2048 cap and falls back to x190_allocate_legacy (391 vs 157 stack accesses).
gameoflife_bisect.fix: Guard p113k_function and p113k_function_done size caps with leaf exemption (allow up to 16384 stmts when Bool.not(w7b_stmts_has_call(body))), matching Wave 7B's leaf guard in x190_joint_frame/x185_function_place.
gameoflife_bisect.estimated_speedup: 2.91x on gameoflife (1267ms -> ~436ms, 0.47x gcc-10); ~15% cut to 7-family proxy geomean
